title: Go: Custom HTTP Router
description: Implement a custom HTTP router from scratch with method matching, path parameters, and middleware support.

steps.title: Route registration
steps.description: Define a `Route` struct with fields `Method`, `Pattern`, and `Handler http.HandlerFunc`. Create a `Router` struct with a `routes []Route` slice and a `Handle(method, pattern string, handler http.HandlerFunc)` method. Register two routes and print them using `fmt.Printf`.
hints: Route stores the raw pattern string
Handle appends to the routes slice

verification.failureMessage: Print each registered route's method and pattern.

steps.title: Method matching
steps.description: Implement `ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)` on `Router` that iterates routes and matches both method and pattern. Return 405 Method Not Allowed if a path matches but method doesn't. Print the matched route using `fmt.Println`.
hints: Iterate routes and check r.Method equality first
Track if any path matched (even if method didn't)

verification.failureMessage: Print the matched route or 405 status.

steps.title: Path parameter extraction
steps.description: Add path parameter support using `:` prefix notation (e.g., `/users/:id`). Split both pattern and request path on `/`, match static segments, and extract dynamic ones into a `Params map[string]string`. Print extracted params using `fmt.Printf`.
hints: Split pattern and path with strings.Split
Segments starting with ':' are dynamic params

verification.failureMessage: Print extracted parameter names and values.

steps.title: Sub-routers with prefix
steps.description: Create a `Group(prefix string) *Router` method that returns a new Router with the prefix. When registering routes on the sub-router, the full pattern is prefix + pattern. Print all routes from both parent and sub-router using `fmt.Println`.
hints: Sub-router stores a reference to the parent or just the prefix
Join prefix and pattern with fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", prefix, pattern)
Routes list should be aggregated for printing

verification.failureMessage: Print routes showing the combined prefix+pattern.

steps.title: Middleware per route group
steps.description: Add a `Use(middlewares ...Middleware)` method to `Router` that applies middlewares to all routes registered within that group. Define a `Middleware` type as `func(http.Handler) http.Handler`. Print middleware application order using `fmt.Printf`.
hints: Middleware type is the same as standard http middleware
Store middlewares on the Router and apply in Handle
Apply middlewares in reverse order: last added = outermost

steps.title: Not Found handler
steps.description: Add a custom 404 handler to `Router` with a `NotFound(handler http.HandlerFunc)` method. When no route matches, use this handler instead of the default. Print the 404 response message using `fmt.Println`.
hints: Store a default NotFound handler field on Router
Fall through to it after checking all routes

verification.failureMessage: Print the 404 response for unmatched routes.
